collection.title: VW Fox 2005 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Fox 2005 Onwards model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.  We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Fox which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
